summary.plain: Of 58 compared genes, 4 change their call when a single sample is set aside, and 7 more when two are. The most fragile: CAMTA2, DPYSL3, IGSF4, PRKACB_bis. 11 samples have a control-gene well far from what their other control genes predict; each makes every value of its sample too high or too low. 19 of 366 samples are in no comparison (see why).

cannot_show: A single target well that is off cannot be told apart from biology without technical replicates.
A fault shared by every sample of one group looks like biology (a design question).
A wrong sample in the tube, RNA integrity, RT replicates and no-RT controls leave no footprint here unless annotated.
Each sample sits at the same well position on every plate, so a position effect cannot be told apart from the sample.
checked: Every compared gene: every sample set aside alone, and every pair of samples where no single one changes the call.
Every sample's control-gene wells against what its other control genes predict.
Every sample's input amount and efficiency across all its plates.
Every study well against its plate's amplifying no-template controls.
trace.rule: up or down only if p < 0.05 and the change is at least 2-fold; otherwise no call
